integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, photorealistic. The opening frame precisely preserves the tight facial close-up established by <Picture 1>, including the adult woman’s facial identity, long dark hair, cream linen dress, direct eye contact, warm late-afternoon sunlight, natural skin texture, and gentle expression. The same wooden seaside beverage stand remains behind her on the left, while the sandy beach, turquoise ocean, and level horizon remain visible on the right. She stays seated on the same wooden chair throughout the shot.

The camera initially holds a Static Shot as the woman looks directly into the lens. Her expression gradually develops into a warm, natural smile. A gentle sea breeze moves individual strands of her hair across her cheeks and shoulders without obscuring her eyes. She blinks once naturally while maintaining eye contact with the camera.

Without any cut, the camera Pulls Out with large amplitude at slow speed, smoothly changing from the tight facial close-up to a medium shot and then a full-body view. Her face, body proportions, cream dress, seated posture, chair, and surrounding structures remain consistent as they are progressively revealed. The full wooden beverage kiosk appears beside her, followed by the surrounding sand and the open beach behind it.

The pull-out gradually accelerates as the camera Pedestals Up with large amplitude at fast speed, rising like a drone while continuing to move backward. The camera Tilts Down with large amplitude at slow speed, continuously transitioning from the eye-level portrait into a high-angle aerial view. The woman remains seated in exactly the same location beside the beverage stand and steadily becomes smaller in the frame. The expanding view reveals the broad sandy beach, scattered distant umbrellas, parallel lines of white surf, turquoise shallows, deep-blue ocean, and the long curve of the coastline.

The camera reaches an extreme-high-angle drone view in which the beverage stand is a small structure and the seated woman has become an extremely small but still visible figure. Toward the very end, one realistic white-and-gray seagull suddenly flies across the immediate foreground from right to left, passing extremely close to the lens. Its body and wings briefly fill a large portion of the frame with strong foreground parallax and natural directional motion blur. The seagull exits completely, leaving the expansive aerial view of the beach and ocean visible in the final moment.

overall_soundscape: Gentle waves roll onto the beach beneath a steady coastal breeze, faint shoreline ambience, softly rustling hair and fabric, and the occasional quiet clink of glass bottles at the beverage stand. As the camera rises, the nearby sounds gradually recede into a broad wash of wind and ocean surf. At the end, one brief seagull call, powerful wingbeats, and a close airborne whoosh cross the foreground.

non_diegetic_music: Soft acoustic-guitar arpeggios at a relaxed tempo with light hand percussion and sustained airy synthesizer tones. The arrangement gradually opens and decreases in volume during the aerial ascent, ending on one sustained note after the seagull passes.
